criteria.name: Hook strength

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.note: Mechanism gates a real procurement/capital decision; AK consequence specified (sector, JBER/Chugach vs Eielson/GVEA, named actors, H2 2026).

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.note: All four layers and controlling actors match the dossier exactly; bullet items are compound run-ons rather than clean single clauses.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.note: One layer (AFICA source-selection), one actor (CO Julia A. Cantrell), one binary decision (enter lease negotiations), asymmetry called out vs RCA/ADNR/Railbelt utilities.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.note: Real grounded position (procurement vehicle not real-estate; the risk-inversion is the mechanism). Proportionate, matches post_001 energy.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.note: Names next observable event (lease-negotiation/award H2 2026) and what to track (firm dispatchable power); window is broad.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.note: Layers 1/4 to af.mil release, layer 2 to SAM.gov/HigherGov mirror; layer 3 RFLP utility text carried by secondary outlets quoting the RFLP.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.note: Analytical, position-taking, structural, Alaska-first, business-literate; on the post_001 register.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.note: Tight paragraphs, 436 words, 2971 chars; four-item bullet block uses compound constructions instead of single-clause items.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.note: Real, debatable question tied directly to the chokepoint (weight on-site generation over a Railbelt interconnection at Cantrell's desk).
